description: This file defines image statistics calculations, including an interface 'Stats', a function 'ssim' for structural similarity index, and a class 'FastStats' implementing efficient statistical computations on image channels.

classes.name: FastStats
classes.description: A class implementing the Stats interface for efficient computation of image channel statistics using partial sums.

methods.name: ssim
methods.description: Calculates the Structural Similarity Index (SSIM) between two regions of images based on provided statistics.
